annotations.text:
ShowBox design v2 (2 Sep 2026): portrait short-drama app in the spirit of NetShort and DramaBox.
Direction: Midnight Marquee. Warm near-black, one amber accent, Bricolage Grotesque + Instrument Sans.
Every video is vertical. Series run 60 to 90 short episodes; the first episodes are free, later ones cost coins or are free with VIP.
Home hero follows Reference/Slide Animation.mp4: the focused card is full size and bright, neighbours are smaller and dimmed, and a glow behind the focused card takes that poster's colour.
The Accent chip above each screen swaps the accent across that screen. All titles, people and artwork are fictional placeholders.

Player and For You share one vertical pager: swipe up for the next episode, swipe sideways for the next series. Tap toggles play and pause; the next video is preloaded so a swipe starts instantly. Hitting a locked episode opens the Unlock sheet.
The canvas shows about ten screens at once; screens further away render when you pan to them.

Coin economy: earn (check-in, ads, tasks, referrals), spend (50 coins per locked episode, auto-unlock optional), top up (packs with bonus tiers), or skip it all with VIP. Purchases are simulated in the demo. All prices and coin amounts are sample values.

Alternate directions (low-fi, Home only)
B Light Editorial: cream paper, serif, magazine pacing. Calmer and less app-like, but posters carry less weight on a light ground.
C Neon Glass: navy, cyan + magenta, glass panels. Flashier, but blur and glow cost GPU time on mid-range Android.
